text.toast.downloadProgress.title: Downloading Voices of Wynn Audio
wynnvp.config.option.anonymous.tooltip: Send missing-line reports without including your player name. This only applies when missing-line reporting is enabled.
wynnvp.config.option.autoProgress.toolti: Once a voice line has actually finished playing, tap sneak for you so the dialogue moves on. Never fires while a dialogue choice is on screen, while a screen is open, or after you have pressed sneak yourself.
wynnvp.config.option.blockCutOff.tooltip: The minimum distance in blocks that the sound will be cut off from the speaker. For some sounds a manual adjustment is set to prevent the sound not being heard
wynnvp.config.option.blockVillagerSounds: Mutes the vanilla mob murmurs Wynncraft plays for each dialogue line (villager, evoker, witch, ravager, zombie ambients and more) while a voice line is playing.
wynnvp.config.option.debugAndLogs.custom: Custom path to audio files. This can be a url starting with (http...) or a local folder path. Spaces are fine, and surrounding quotes or backslash-escaped spaces are accepted too.

Path to a custom sounds.json file containing dialogue-to-audio mappings. This will override the default sounds.json. Spaces are fine, and surrounding quotes or backslash-escaped spaces are accepted too.
wynnvp.config.option.debugAndLogs.debugS: Draws the traced sound rays as particles and logs the worked-out reverb and muffling values.
wynnvp.config.option.debugAndLogs.highli: Should there be an aura of particles highlighting the source of the sound? This is mostly useful for debugging
wynnvp.config.option.debugAndLogs.logAut: Log every decision auto progress makes to the game log: when it arms for a line, when playback starts and ends, when it taps sneak, and why it gave up (dialogue choice on screen, you sneaked yourself, a screen opened, and so on).
wynnvp.config.option.debugAndLogs.logBlo: Log every sound the game tries to play while a voice line is active, and whether it was blocked.
wynnvp.config.option.debugAndLogs.logDia: If each time a dialogue that is encountered should be put into the vowlog.txt file
wynnvp.config.option.debugAndLogs.logOve: Print overlay-based dialogue lines (e.g. from Fruma) into the chat as they are detected. Useful for debugging the overlay dialogue system.
Log every overlay packet's extracted npc and body text to vowLog.txt. Use this to capture real packet sequences from in-game and replay them as unit tests.
wynnvp.config.option.debugAndLogs.logPla: Log a bunch of miscellaneous things about playing sounds
wynnvp.config.option.debugAndLogs.onlyLo: A setting for logDialogueLines to only log missing lines
wynnvp.config.option.debugAndLogs.useCus: If the custom audio path should be used that is defined in the next option
Enable loading dialogue mappings from a custom sounds.json file instead of the default one
wynnvp.config.option.downloadSounds.tool: If all sounds should be downloaded. Enable this if you experience high latency in audio playback
wynnvp.config.option.earlyPlayOverlay.to: Start playing dialogue as soon as a partial line matches, before the typewriter animation finishes. Disable to only play after the full line is received. Note: when voice acting is missing for a line, an early partial match may cause the wrong audio to play.
wynnvp.config.option.earlyPlayOverlayMin: Minimum number of characters a partial line must match before early audio playback is triggered. Lines shorter than this threshold will play once the full line is received instead.
wynnvp.config.option.enableReverb.toolti: Adds environmental reverb effects to NPC voices based on their location (caves, buildings, etc.)
wynnvp.config.option.nicknameOverride.to: If you use a Wynncraft Nickname, enter it here. It will be replaced alongside your real username when matching dialogue lines to audio. One nickname only — this is matched as literal text, so a list separated by commas will not work.
wynnvp.config.option.playAllSoundsOnPlay: This will disable the stereo effect of voices.
wynnvp.config.option.playbackSpeed.toolt: Controls the speed of voice playback. 100% is normal speed, lower values slow down speech, higher values speed it up. Might introduce audio artifacts.
wynnvp.config.option.questFeedbackPrompt: Ask for an anonymous rating after quest completion if voice audio started in the last 15 minutes. Feedback uses a random installation identifier, never your Minecraft name or UUID.
Send a report when Voices of Wynn cannot find audio for a dialogue line. The anonymous and fun-fact options below only apply while this is enabled.
wynnvp.config.option.routeMasterSoundsTo: Wynncraft plays many of its sound effects on Minecraft's Master category, so they become very loud. This moves them onto the Blocks slider so you can set their volume separately.
wynnvp.config.option.sendFunFact.tooltip: Include a small optional fact in missing-line reports. This only applies when missing-line reporting is enabled.
wynnvp.config.option.soundPhysics.toolti: Works out reverb and muffling from the blocks around the speaker.
wynnvp.config.option.soundPhysicsOcclusi: How muffled a voice gets when there are blocks between you and the speaker. Voices always stay understandable; 0% turns muffling off.
wynnvp.config.option.soundPhysicsRays.to: How many rays are traced each update. Higher is more accurate and slightly more expensive.
wynnvp.config.option.soundPhysicsReverbS: How wet the worked-out reverb sounds. 100% is the physically modelled amount; 0% leaves the voice dry without turning off muffling.
wynnvp.config.option.voiceVolume.tooltip: Adjusts the volume of voices played.
